objective: Test whether point-in-time company information and persistent research/model memory improve the frozen deterministic 12-1 stock-momentum champion without leaking future information or creating order authority.

sources.core_claim: Nonlinear models can extract interactions among momentum, liquidity, volatility and other equity characteristics, but shallow models remain competitive in low-signal panels.
sources.project_applicability: Keep a strong linear/tree/ranker comparison and require matched feature ablations instead of assuming model complexity adds value.
sources.reflection: The paper uses a much broader point-in-time universe and longer history than this current-universe exploratory dataset.

sources.credibility: public R&D-Agent(Q) research paper and implementation project
sources.core_claim: Quant research agents can alternate hypothesis generation, factor implementation and experiment feedback instead of treating factor and model search as isolated stages.
sources.project_applicability: Link source claims, factor proposals, empirical outcomes and next decisions in a persistent knowledge index.
sources.reflection: Agent-generated breadth still creates multiple-testing risk and does not replace strict OOS evaluation.

sources.core_claim: LLMs can generate executable alpha candidates more reliably than they can judge alpha quality without empirical feedback; diversity and OOS generalization need explicit evaluation.
sources.project_applicability: Use the LLM for bounded candidate and text-feature generation while the deterministic harness performs selection and records failures.
sources.reflection: Benchmark task performance is not evidence of tradable alpha in the Open Composer data environment.

sources.credibility: academic working paper on LLM news interpretation and returns
sources.core_claim: Structured LLM interpretation of company news may contain short-horizon return information beyond simple sentiment labels.
sources.project_applicability: Test catalyst confirmation, false-momentum veto and text-only diagnostics using PIT packets.
sources.reflection: Historical LLM transformations can inherit model-training-time knowledge and must be grounded in quoted input spans and treated as retrospective.

sources.core_claim: Momentum systems can combine trend, volatility scaling and learned nonlinear temporal interactions.
sources.project_applicability: Supports separate return-ranking, downside-risk and regime roles rather than one monolithic buy/sell model.
sources.reflection: Futures evidence and deep sequence models do not directly validate a small long-only stock panel.

sources.core_claim: Momentum losses cluster in stressed reversal regimes and can be partly forecast with market-state information.
sources.project_applicability: Use regime and risk models to decide when ML may alter the champion instead of replacing the champion unconditionally.
sources.reflection: Long-short momentum crash results may overstate the risk for this long-only Top-K strategy.

sources.credibility: peer-reviewed Review of Financial Studies advance article
sources.core_claim: Generative AI adoption in asset management is associated with value from processing firm-specific information.
sources.project_applicability: Prioritize company filings, earnings releases and catalyst extraction over more transformations of price alone.
sources.reflection: Institution-level adoption evidence is not a causal guarantee that one LLM feature improves this strategy.

sources.credibility: peer-reviewed Review of Financial Studies advance article
sources.core_claim: Disagreement among machine predictions can contain cross-sectional information rather than serving only as a generic uncertainty warning.
sources.project_applicability: Evaluate model disagreement both as a feature and as an abstention/meta-gate input.
sources.reflection: Using disagreement after observing challenge results would overfit; thresholds must be selected in training folds.

sources.credibility: peer-reviewed Review of Financial Studies advance article
sources.core_claim: Day and night return components can exhibit materially different momentum behavior.
sources.project_applicability: Split total momentum into intraday, overnight and gap components before asking ML to learn their interactions.
sources.reflection: The result needs direct replication on the selected universe and Longbridge bar conventions.

sources.credibility: peer-reviewed Review of Financial Studies advance article
sources.core_claim: Prediction objectives that ignore implementation costs can select transient or expensive signals; portfolio construction should account for turnover and costs.
sources.project_applicability: Compare Top-K prediction with cost-aware shrinkage toward deterministic weights.
sources.reflection: Estimated costs are only proxies until forward execution observations accumulate.

sources.credibility: official U.S. SEC EDGAR API documentation
sources.core_claim: SEC submissions and company facts are available as structured public endpoints with filing timestamps and accession identifiers.
sources.project_applicability: Use accession, acceptance/publication time and document hashes as the source of truth for filing PIT packets.
sources.reflection: SEC access policy and User-Agent requirements must be respected; filing metadata is not equivalent to licensed transcripts.

sources.core_claim: The provider exposes timestamped ticker-aware news and sentiment fields subject to API plan coverage.
sources.project_applicability: Treat it as an optional registered news source and preserve provider timestamps and coverage warnings.
sources.reflection: The workspace currently lacks an Alpha Vantage key and cannot claim historical or paper-ready coverage.

sources.core_claim: GDELT offers broad timestamped document search suitable for event discovery and narrative monitoring.
sources.project_applicability: Use GDELT for forward event discovery, with symbol/entity matching and duplicate controls before feature generation.
sources.reflection: Coverage, entity resolution and full historical retrieval are not sufficient by themselves for paper-ready company news evidence.

sources.core_claim: Reusable feature handlers, experiment records and model workflows help preserve research outputs across iterations.
sources.project_applicability: Store feature contracts, data snapshots, model hashes and experiment decisions rather than only final weights.
sources.reflection: Qlib patterns do not remove Open Composer's PIT, survivorship and broker-safety requirements.

topic_coverage: point-in-time replay and historical LLM backfill risk

candidate_matrix_revisions.reason: Freeze deterministic 12-1 as champion and require all ML/text variants to beat matched dates and costs.
Add grounded SEC/news text features plus non-LLM event baselines and placebos.
Train role-specific rank, risk and meta models instead of adding unconstrained model families.
Test cost-aware shrinkage and model disagreement while preserving exact deterministic fallback.
